Major AI Developments.title: Kishan Reddy & Gen VK Singh join industry leaders at IEI Excellence Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: At the IEI Excellence Summit in Delhi, leaders called for India to move from manufacturing to global engineering design, highlighting tech, talent, and trust, with NIT Meghalaya winning top honors.

Major AI Developments.title: AI, shifting industries are redefining careers: Market experts
Major AI Developments.summary: Market experts are warning that AI and shifting industries are redefining careers, requiring graduates to adapt beyond their traditional learning. Financial experts are advising students at the Indian Institute of Management-Shillong to be prepared for these changes. This shift is expected to impact the job market and career paths for new graduates and postgraduates.
